'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Chris Westergard DS Coruscant: Chancellor's Office (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
